reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.03717. Abstract summary: Infrared small target detection faces the inherent challenge of precisely localizing dim targets amidst complex background clutter. Traditional approaches struggle to balance detection precision and false alarm rates. To break this dilemma, we propose SeRankDet, a deep network that achieves high accuracy beyond the conventional Out of scope: Infrared image target detection model, not LLM inference.
title: Pick of the Bunch: Detecting Infrared Small Targets Beyond Hit-Miss Trade-Offs via Selective Rank-Aware Attention
